reviews.reviewtitle: Critics have called this rip everything from Shit to Fucking Shit
reviews.reviewbody: Nah, it’s a good rip. Props to the uploader.
This show of his is very reminiscent of his stint with Weekend Update, I cherish it very much
This show was instantly funny and stayed that way, but the sports stars he roasted are notoriously sensitive and it couldn't last. Shame
